card.name: hammerdb-rhel9
card.role: runs the database and the load generator

def.what: A saved description of a RHEL guest.
def.creator: The workload administrator.
def.reader: OpenShift Virtualization creates the running guest.
def.where: The hammerdb namespace on a spoke.
def.analogy: A machine blueprint, not the running machine itself.

card.name: hammerdb-rhel9-rootdisk
card.role: prepares a disk and owns its persistent volume claim

def.what: A request to prepare a VM disk.
def.creator: The workload administrator.
def.reader: The Containerized Data Importer prepares its disk claim.
def.where: The hammerdb namespace on a spoke.
def.analogy: A disk preparation order with a claim receipt.

card.name: powerstore-sc
card.role: tells Kubernetes how to provision a PowerStore disk

def.creator: The storage administrator.
def.reader: The CSI provisioner and Dell driver.
def.analogy: A catalog entry for ordering a disk.

card.name: powerstore-vrc-15m
card.role: selects the driver and replication settings

def.creator: The storage administrator.
def.analogy: The delivery contract for the recovery copy.

card.name: hammerdb-rhel9-datadisk
card.role: asks the driver to replicate or change one disk role

def.what: A replication request for one protected disk.
def.creator: Ramen's spoke controller.
def.reader: csi-addons translates it into Dell CSI driver requests.
def.where: The hammerdb namespace on a spoke.
def.analogy: A work order for one disk copy.

card.name: hammerdb-drpc
card.role: coordinates both protected VM disks on one spoke

def.what: The local coordinator for a group of protected disks.
def.creator: Ramen delivers it from the hub.
def.where: openshift-dr-ops on both spokes for this discovered app.
def.analogy: The foreman coordinating the disk work orders.

card.name: dr-policy-15m
card.role: pairs the sites and sets the permitted data-loss window

def.what: The disaster recovery agreement between two sites.
def.creator: The DR administrator.
def.analogy: A recovery contract with a fifteen-minute objective.

card.name: hammerdb-placement
card.role: lets Ramen decide which cluster should run the app

def.what: The request for a workload's selected cluster.
def.creator: The DR administrator.
def.reader: Ramen controls the selection during recovery.
def.analogy: A destination request whose choice is delegated to Ramen.

card.name: PlacementDecision
card.role: kind only, generated instance name not asserted

def.what: The answer to the Placement request.
def.creator: The placement and recovery controllers.
def.where: The Placement namespace on the hub.
def.analogy: The destination written on the dispatch board.

card.name: hammerdb-drpc
card.role: connects the workload to its recovery policy and placement

def.creator: The DR administrator through enrollment.
def.reader: Ramen's hub controller and the DR console.
def.analogy: A control sheet joining the policy, workload and destination.

card.name: ManifestWork
card.role: kind only, carries hub instructions to the spoke

def.what: A package of Kubernetes resources to apply on a spoke.
def.creator: Ramen on the hub.
def.reader: ACM's work agent on the destination spoke.
def.where: The managed cluster's namespace on the hub.

1.12.unverified: Exact generated ManifestWork instance name and deployed controller commit are not asserted.

card.name: ManagedClusterView
card.role: kind only, returns resource observations to the hub

def.what: A request to observe a spoke resource.
def.creator: Ramen on the hub.
def.reader: ACM's view agent and Ramen's hub controller.
def.where: The managed cluster's namespace on the hub.
def.analogy: A return receipt showing what happened at the destination.

1.13.unverified: Exact generated ManagedClusterView instance name and deployed controller commit are not asserted.

card.name: ramen-metadata
card.role: stores disk metadata and saved workload objects

def.creator: The infrastructure administrator provisions MinIO and its bucket.
def.reader: Ramen and the backup and restore components.
def.analogy: An off-site filing cabinet, not the database disk itself.

card.name: velero
card.role: saves and restores the Kubernetes objects needed by the VM

def.what: The Kubernetes-object backup and restore engine.
def.creator: OADP installs the components and Ramen requests recovery.
def.reader: Velero processes the backup and restore requests.
def.analogy: Rebuilding the machine blueprint from the filing cabinet.

card.name: spoke-1
card.role: reports whether the hub can hear from the source cluster

def.what: The hub's registration and availability record for a spoke.
def.creator: The cluster administrator imports the spoke.
def.reader: ACM hub controllers and management interfaces.
def.analogy: A site's check-in record, not a test of every workload.
